Snehalata Yadav
--Petitioner
Versus
State Of Uttarakhand and Others
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vinod Tiwari, learned counsel for 
petitioner.
2. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned D.A.G. for 
the State of Uttarakhand/respondents.
3. This Court has directed learned 
State Counsel to get instruction in the 
matter vide order dated 14.08.2026.
4. Today, learned State Counsel has 
passed on written instruction dated 
17.08.2026 to this Court, which is taken 
on record, and submitted that under 
Section 17(1)(b) of the Uttarakhand 
Annual Transfer for Public Servants Act, 
2017, (in short ‘the Transfer Act’), the 
transfer on request are to be made, but 
the request made by the Teacher/
Government Employee, shall be 
considered in the order as enumerated in 
Sub-Section (i) to (iv) of Section 
17(1)(b) of the Transfer Act. 
5. Since petitioner has made a request
for transfer at one of four places given in 
her application under the spouse policy,
as her husband is working in Ramnagar, 
therefore, if any vacancy remains  available, petitioner shall be 
accommodated against that vacancy. 
6. In the aforesaid instruction, it is not 
clear as to how many applications have 
been received by the respondent￾department on request transfer under (i) 
to (iv) of Section 17(1)(b) of the 
Transfer Act.
7. Learned State Counsel is directed to 
get the concrete information regarding 
the aforesaid aspect, within three days.
8. Learned counsel for petitioner 
passed on to this Court order dated 
03.08.2026 passed by respondent￾Additional Director, Secondary 
Education, Kumaun Mandal, in which one 
Teacher-Smt. Beena Shail has been 
transferred from Khetikhan, District
Champawat to Banbhoolpura, District 
Haldwani, on one of the options given by 
her.
9. Learned counsel for petitioner 
submits that it is also be asked from 
State as to how this transfer has been 
effected on the option made by the said 
Smt. Beena Shail.
10. Learned State Counsel is also 
directed to get instruction in respect of 
this transfer order dated 03.08.2026.
11. Put up as fresh on 25.08.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 19.08.2026
PN

3. The instruction has been received 
pursuant to the order dated 19.08.2026 
passed by this Court, which are taken on 
record.
4. It is contended by the learned State 
Counsel that under spouse policy as 
many as 10 applications are pending 
disposal along with the petitioner’s 
application; further the transfer which is
alleged by petitioner regarding the 
transfer of Smt. Beena Shail from 
Khetikhan, District Champawat to 
Banbhoolpura, Haldwani, in that regard, 
it is contended by learned State Counsel 
on the basis of instructions that it is not a 
transfer, rather it is an attachment. 
5. This Court is satisfied with the  instructions. 
6. The respondents may file the counter 
affidavit within a period of four weeks.
7. List this case on 29.09.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
